topic: 身边的人与物 · Independent new scenario: a shared flat and the people who live there
grammarFocus: he / she / it；is；a / an；单数名词；this / that。 Teach the new rule in Chinese, then provide at least 8 distinct grammar questions in new sentences. Distinguish a newly taught form from revision. All main reading/listening question prompts and options must be English, with short A0/A1 English prompts. Chinese explanations are allowed. sourcePolicy: Project-original scenario; simulated figures and people; no copied official test, textbook, GitHub PDF or third-party audio.
title: The New Flatmate
instructions: 这是为A1学习者设计的原创听力练习，场景为合租公寓。请先听录音（由不同美音朗读），注意he/she/it、is、a/an、this/that的用法。然后完成8道听力题。之后学习语法规则并做8道语法题。所有题目均为英文，解释为中文。本材料为模拟教学材料，非官方雅思考试。
transcript:
Mia: Hi, Ben. This is our flat. That is the kitchen.
Ben: Hi, Mia. It is small but nice. Who is she?
Mia: She is Lucy. She is a teacher. She is not a student.
Ben: And who is he?
Mia: He is Tom. He is a cook. He is not a doctor.
Ben: Is that your room?
Mia: No, that is Tom's room. This is my room. It is big.
Ben: Is Lucy a nurse?
Mia: No, she is not a nurse. She is a teacher.
Ben: OK. Is Tom a teacher?
Mia: No, he is a cook. He is not a teacher.
Ben: Thanks, Mia.

questions.explanation: Mia说“She is a teacher.”，所以Lucy是老师。
Mia说“He is a cook.”，所以Tom是厨师。
Mia明确说“No, she is not a nurse.”，所以Lucy不是护士。
questions.evidence: No, she is not a nurse.

questions.explanation: Mia说“No, he is a cook. He is not a teacher.”，所以Tom不是老师。
Mia说“This is my room. It is big.”，所以她的房间大。
questions.evidence: This is my room. It is big.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: That is the ______.
questions.explanation: Mia说“That is the kitchen.”，所以填kitchen。

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: She is a ______.
questions.explanation: Mia说“She is a teacher.”，所以填teacher。
Mia说“He is a cook.”，所以Tom是厨师。

vocabulary.example: No, she is not a nurse.

grammar.title: he / she / it；is；a / an；单数名词；this / that
grammar.explanation: 在英语中，我们用he指代男性，she指代女性，it指代事物或动物。be动词is用于第三人称单数（he/she/it）。不定冠词a用于辅音音素开头的单数名词前，an用于元音音素开头的单数名词前。this指近处的人或物，that指远处的人或物。例如：He is a cook. She is a teacher. It is a kitchen. This is my room. That is Tom's room.
grammar.example: She is a teacher. He is a cook. It is big. This is my room. That is the kitchen.

questions.prompt: ______ is a book. (this thing near you)

questions.explanation: 主语she是第三人称单数，be动词用is。
cook以辅音音素开头，用a。这里指一个非特定的厨师。
nurse以辅音音素开头，用a。这里指一个非特定的护士。
